pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all seeded rows are 0 and that 2 is rejected.
'AC-2' test checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order after marking item 2 done.
'AC-3' marks 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /; the current view is a <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views after DELETE; the src/index.js COUNT fallback implements it.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; 'AC-8' checks it. scripts/traffic-config-check.mjs now accepts query strings, and tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers that.

findings.what: The AC-8 test only reads routes.json. It doesn't run the routes against the app, so it wouldn't catch a listed route that returns non-2xx.
findings.fix: Optionally fetch each route in routes.json against the Worker and assert 200.

lenses.note: Spec present with the owner's go (2026-10-12); the decisions on the default view and the query parameter are followed. The spec was not edited after the go.
All 8 acceptance items are named by tests. All 6 state-table rows have a test. Nothing was added beyond the ask except the traffic-config checker change, which AC-8 needs and the PR discloses.

Tests assert rendered list items, messages and status codes, and would fail on broken code. No tests were deleted. test/traffic.test.js changed only to record the query string. I did not run the tests here; per the project, CI runs them.
README describes the views. CLAUDE.md and the README already say that a new feature adds its routes to traffic/routes.json.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ and an empty value give 400. The SQL is built only from fixed strings. The empty-table fallback is correct.
The query value is never interpolated into SQL or HTML, and titles are still escaped. The relaxed route regex still refuses spaces and #.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no UI framework or style files, and no screenshots exist. The only markup is the nav and list, checked by the AC-5 test.
There is no browser in the session and no UI flow beyond plain links, which the tests cover.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: behaviour change, 400 on other values, migration, traffic checker change and no loosened tests.
